preview.notes: Manager setters can alter bases/sizes. No complete call graph proof that no other caller or resource uses remaining VRAM. PC preview creation at (44,84,0), transfer through PokemonSpriteManager_UpdateCharAndPltt. Frame task resets G3X and matrix stack, sets software sprite camera, draws manager then swaps Z buffers. BG0 priority 1, original icons are OBJ; same BG0 layer cannot necessarily reproduce OBJ priority relationship. Native geometry/alpha/UI layer compatibility unverified.

gx.notes: GX_LoadTex/Pltt region checks and DMA; async palette transfer requires lifetime and synchronization proof. Texture bank A and palette F/G; no native free range authorized.

scroll.notes: Source publishes offset before increment; column preparation is separate task and not simulated.

independent.armObject: ELF32 LSB ARM EABI5 relocatable; two global functions
